topic: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, FaaS and deployment models
title: Who manages what? Classify the services
instructions:
## The responsibility split

At each service level the provider takes over more of the stack: hardware, virtualisation, operating system, runtime, application, data. Classify each offering, and pick a deployment model for two Ghanaian cases.

Answer the questions on the right. The **Billing** tab shows how the pricing differs between a VM and a function if you create one of each.
hints: IaaS gives you a machine you administer; PaaS runs your code on a managed platform; SaaS is a finished application; FaaS runs single functions on demand.
A regulator that requires data to stay in-country points to a private or community cloud hosted locally, or an in-country region.
